headlines.title: Is Airbnb (ABNB) Still Undervalued On Growth Hopes And Its American Express Deal?
headlines.summary: Airbnb (ABNB) is back in focus after analysts flagged projected year-over-year gains in upcoming quarterly results, as the company rolls out guest-friendly rule changes and deepens distribution through a new American Express partnership. Recent trading shows that Airbnb’s share price has built solid upward momentum over 2026, with a year to date share price return of 25.52% and a 1 year total shareholder return of 36.29%. This comes even though the stock slipped 2.43% on the day to US$166.

headlines.title: Airbnb (ABNB) Brings Over 1 Million Listings To A Major Card Travel Portal
headlines.summary: Airbnb (NasdaqGS:ABNB) and American Express have partnered to list over 1 million Airbnb properties on the Amex Travel platform. Eligible U.S. American Express Card Members can now earn Membership Rewards points and receive statement credits on Airbnb bookings made through Amex Travel. The arrangement connects Airbnb hosts with American Express's higher spending travel customers through a new distribution channel inside the issuer's booking portal.

headlines.title: Booking Holdings’ Lowest Recent Target Still Implies 22% Upside. Airbnb’s Growth Tests the Estimates Behind It
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysEvery recent price target on Booking Holdings (BKNG:NASDAQ) is above the stock, from Wells Fargo’s $190 to UBS’s $265, even after a 27% drop this year. Wall Street’s estimates already have Airbnb’s (ABNB:NASDAQ) revenue growing faster than Booking’s this year and next, so the bear case that Booking is losing share is mostly priced in.

headlines.title: Airbnb to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in Store for the Stock?
headlines.summary: ABNB's Q3 results are likely to benefit from strong travel demand, rising bookings, and AI-driven enhancements, but higher costs might have pressured margins.

headlines.title: Broken Bow Short Term Rental Realtor Cathy Craig Has Helped Investors Buy 226 Cabins
headlines.summary: Cathy Craig is a short term rental real estate agent in Broken Bow, Oklahoma, with The Short Term Shop, a brokerage that works only with vacation rental investors. Since late 2021, Craig has helped investors buy 226 Airbnb and VRBO cabins in Broken Bow and Hochatown, worth more than $163 million.

description: Airbnb, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates a platform for stays, experiences, and services worldwide. The company's marketplace connects hosts and guests online or through mobile devices to book spaces, experiences, and services. It also offers gift cards. The company was formerly known as AirBed & Breakfast, Inc. and changed its name to Airbnb, Inc. in November 2010. Airbnb, Inc. was founded in 2007 and is headquartered in San Francisco, California.
